_documentation.in_scope_workbooks: Run 'make profile-drive-folder' first, then extract workbook codes from the drive tree output that match workbook_id_regex.
_documentation.operational_tokens: Words from your domain that indicate primary data-entry tabs. Consider the operational loop in your raw notes.
_documentation.reference_tokens: Words indicating lookup/reference tabs (variety lists, crop codes, etc.).
_documentation.reference_combo_tokens: Lists of words that must all appear for a reference combo match.
_documentation.support_tokens: Words indicating helper/index/validation tabs (penalized in scoring).
_documentation.derived_tokens: Words indicating auto-generated/pivot/summary tabs (penalized in scoring).
_documentation.tab_auto_limit: Maximum tabs auto-selected per workbook code. Use tab_selection_overrides to hand-pick important tabs.
_documentation.tab_exclude_patterns: Regex patterns to block tabs. Each entry: {"pattern": "regex", "penalty": -5}.
_documentation.year_regex: Used to group workbooks by year. Set year_scope in domain_context.yaml to limit profiling to active years.
_documentation.domain_context: Path to a domain_context.yaml file providing vocabulary, year scoping, deduplication, and glossary.

tab_selection_overrides.replace: When true, replaces the auto-selected tabs with the explicitly listed tabs. When false (default), adds or removes tabs relative to auto-selection.
tab_selection_overrides.tabs: List of tab names to include. Matched against workbook tab names (case-insensitive prefix). Use exact names or prefix fragments.
tab_selection_overrides.add: Tab names to add on top of auto-selection. Only applied when replace is false.
tab_selection_overrides.remove: Tab names to remove from auto-selection. Only applied when replace is false.

include: Using replace: true when you only want to add a tab — set add instead.
Listing tabs not actually present in the workbook — check exact names from Phase 1 output.
Forgetting that replace: true wipes auto-selection entirely; add and remove are ignored.
Mismatching workbook codes in in_scope_workbooks — override targets tabs in the wrong workbook.

_documentation.pivot_detection_threshold: Ratio of numeric column headers that triggers pivot-table rejection in scaffold_workbook_schema. Set to 1.0 or null to disable.
